But the archived agent's Charter section keeps rendering CharterPicker (AgentSettingsPage.tsx:124-135), and on failure it shows only its own generic 'Could not update charter binding.' -- the server's sentence is dropped, which is the F187 shape. ship the backend refusal alone and file the picker as its own finding
